title: Girl in Purple [Akemi Homura]
description:
Hi! I'm an Artist, Indie Game Developer and YouTuber
[url=https://allmylinks.com/mystix]~See my links: (My art, my YouTube, give a tip, etc...)[/url] 
~
Enjoy watching this Fantasy scene of "Akemi Homura", an anime girl in purple.

Working with a static image, I added in effects of the rippling reflective water, a bit of a "sparkling" effect on the water, a slight mist over parts of the image, an aurora borealis effect, glowing particles / magical-like "fireflies" floating around, some glimmering stars, the occasional shooting-stars, a glowing light in the girl's hand, gave the girl a "breathing" effect. I've also included according background ambient sounds.

Video is high-definition (HD) and was rendered in 1920x1080 resolution and at 60FPS.  
I've tried to make the audio and visual loop as seemlessly as I was able to.
~~~~~

title: GENSHIN Yelan
description:
GENSHIN Yelan
Fixed a bug that moving the mouse to the right edge would make the edge of the clock invisible.
Please get the newly posted wallpaper.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1323320794

1. Depending on the resolution of the display, the position of the clock may change. Look for the corresponding folder in C: \ Program Files (x86) \ Steam \ steamapps \ workshop \ content.
Open index.html with something like Notepad ++. <Div style = "position: absolute; left: 440px; top: 340px;" class = "time" id = "time" data - hours = "" Change the resolution of the data - minutes = "">.

2. Explain how to change the color of the clock.
Look for the corresponding folder in C: \ Program Files (x86) \ Steam \ steamapps \ workshop \ content.
Open style.css in the CSS folder with something like Notepad ++.
https://html-color.codes/
Search for the color you like, search for #0000ff and replace with Ctrl + h

3. You can make sure that the direction of the clock does not change with the mouse, and it is also possible not to display the clock only.

3 will answer only when asked.

Supplement: Please comment if you can not understand. I'm sorry if I made a mistranslation.
